question: Specifications of the Football is: a circumference should be between ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**68 cm and 70 cm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **circumference** of a standard football is measured according to official regulations.
 
• A standard football used in professional games typically has a circumference of **68-70 cm**.
 
• This measurement is specified by official football governing bodies like **FIFA**.
 
• The correct option for the circumference of a standard football is **Option 3: 68-70 cm**.
 
• These specifications ensure uniformity in the game and fairness across all matches.

 Football Terminology
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Goal
 The main objective in football, where the ball must cross the goal line between the goalposts and beneath the crossbar.
 
 

 Offside
 A rule violation where an attacking player is nearer to the opponent's goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent.
 
 

 Corner Kick
 A method of restarting play when the ball has crossed the goal line without a goal being scored, last touched by a defending player.
 
 

 Yellow Card
 A caution given to a player for various offenses, such as unsporting behavior or dissent.
 
 

 Red Card
 A penalty card that signifies a player's ejection from the game for serious offenses.
 
 

 Penalty Kick
 A direct free kick taken from the penalty mark, awarded for certain fouls committed inside the penalty area.
 
 

 Free Kick
 A kick awarded to a team following various fouls, which can either be direct (can score directly) or indirect (must touch another player before scoring).
 
 

 Throw-in
 A method of restarting play when the ball has crossed the touchline, awarded to the opponents of the player who last touched the ball.
 
 

 Dribbling
 The skill of controlling and maneuvering the ball with the feet while moving across the field.
